infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ishiki uses the camera only when you choose to attach a receipt or record.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Ishiki reads only the Apple Health types you select to show personal trends.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Ishiki writes one synthetic activity sample only during the development HealthKit smoke test, then removes it.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Ishiki to attach a photo you choose to capture.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow Ishiki to attach a photo you choose.
